title: Design: A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440 px in light theme shows every column
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Have open documents in these reports at two locations, so the Location column shows.
  • Have a vendor, vendor A, with a long name (more than 40 characters) and open documents at both locations on today's date, including a vendor credit (its Transaction Type is the longest).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, in light theme at 100% zoom.
  • Open A/P Unpaid Invoices (Reports, then "A/P Unpaid Invoices" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu; the page title reads "A/P Unpaid Invoices Report").
  • Leave the report with every group expanded (Expand all).
  • Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.

Setup

  1. Locations to use: Use "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" as location A (it comes first in A to Z order) and "Staging Lethbridge - 4310" as location B. To work at location B, click the location name and your initials at the top right of the top bar, then Change Location, then "Staging Lethbridge - 4310"; switch back to "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919" the same way when you are done.
  2. Make vendor A: Click Parts in the top bar, then Vendors in the left menu, then New Vendor. Type the Name ZZAUTOTEST Northern Alberta Heavy Haul and Towing Ltd (more than 40 characters), pick Credit Terms "Net 30" and Taxes "Exempt (0%)", then click Save & Close.
  3. Make bill 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Purchase Orders in the left menu, then New PO. Pick vendor A in Vendor. In Part Number type a new part number and click "Add new special order part: …"; type a Description, 1 in Quantity and 300.00 in Cost; click Add, then Save & Close. In the Purchase Orders list click Receive on that order (Vendor column: vendor A); type a Vendor Invoice # (for example bill 1), type today's date in Invoice Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Receive Parts (1).
  4. Make bill 2: While switched to location B (see the Locations to use item): Same way as bill 1, with vendor A in Vendor: Cost 200.00; type today's date in Invoice Date.
  5. Make vendor credit 1: Click Parts in the top bar, then Returns in the left menu, then Create Return. Pick vendor A in Vendor, type a Packaging Slip, pick the part received on bill 1 in Part Number, type 50.00 in Price Per Unit, then click Save Return. In the Returns list tick that return and click Receive Credit; type a Credit Memo Number, type today's date in Credit Date, type 0 in Tax, then click Post Credit.
custom_steps:
1. Look at the title row.
  2. Look at where the filter row sits, and compare with Sales By Customer.
  3. Read the column headings left to right, letter for letter, capitals included.
  4. Look for a sideways scroll bar below the last row of the report page.
  5. Look at vendor A's rows: the name and Transaction Type cells, and the money, date and number cells.
  6. Look across the whole page for any text that overlaps, is cut off or is clipped.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title, its info icon directly right of it, and the ⋯ Export button at the right end, all on one line.

Step 2:

  • The filter row sits below the title row, in the same place as on Sales By Customer.

Step 3:

  • "Date", "Location", "Transaction Type", "No.", "Vendor Name", "Due Date", "Past Due", "Amount", "Open Balance" ("Location" shown because two locations are in view; it sits right after "Date").
  • No heading wraps.

Step 4:

  • There is none: every column is visible at 1440 px without scrolling sideways.

Step 5:

  • The long name and a long Transaction Type wrap onto a second line.
  • Money, date and number cells stay on one line, and a long location name wraps onto a second line (Location wraps only here and on A/P Detail).

Step 6:

  • Nothing overlaps, is cut off or clipped.

Where the tech plan differs: the tech plan (21 Oct 2026) says Location wraps only on A/P Detail; PRD version 11 (its layout rules, 5 Nov 2026) lets it wrap on A/P Unpaid Invoices too. This case follows the PRD.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11532 (Story 2, Sort by clicking any column header), story SV-11536 (Story 6, Location column), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R2: “The title, its info icon and the Export menu stay on one line at 1440 pixels wide; the filter row sits below them, positioned as on the native reports.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction Type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns) and A/P Unpaid Invoices, column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S2-R1, A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices columns: “A/P Detail and A/P Unpaid Invoices: Date, Location (when shown), Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount, Open Balance.”
  • S2-R4a: “Column headings are in Title Case on all six reports, on screen, in the PDF and in the CSV, as on the other reports (Sales By Customer, Inventory Value, Parts Velocity): the A/R reports read "Transaction Type", "Customer Full Name", "Due Date", "Past Due" and "Open Balance", the same as the A/P reports.”
  • S6-R3: “It sits right after the Date column, before the money columns; on A/R Summary and A/P Summary, which have no Date column, right after the customer or vendor name.”
  • Key Decisions, reuse rule: “The reuse rule. Every control on these reports reuses an existing ShopView pattern: the native filter chips, the native totals row and pinned headline column of the newer reports, the existing location-switch prompt, the design system's chevron icon. Nothing new is drawn. Basis: d-reuse-existing-pattern.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §7 Manual testing checklist: “1. At 1440 px every column of all six reports fits; headings never wrap; Location wraps only on A/P Detail (S8-R3).”

Last checked against build v26.45.2-6a8b89c (QA site sv11315) on 11/10/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 3 "Collapse all and pinned group rows" (board Grouped.dc.html); page 6 "Descriptions and pinned column" (board Layout.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD and tech plan quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

  • ar-ap-p3-same-on-a-p-unpaid-invoices.png: figure "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices" (This build (after)), board "3. Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows"
  • ar-ap-p6-a-p-detail-scrolled-sideways-light.png: figure "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light" (Production (before)), board "6. Report descriptions and the pinned headline column" (today's look, for comparison only)

The design's own words:

  • "At 1440 pixels every column fits without sideways scrolling: Date, Location, Transaction Type, No., Vendor Name, Due Date, Past Due, Amount and the pinned, bold Open Balance. Group labels span to the total; text columns wrap. S8-R3." (caption of "A/P Unpaid Invoices at 1440: every column visible")
  • "Vendor rows pin the same way; re-sorting never collapses an open group. S4-R6, S2-R9." (caption of "Same on A/P Unpaid Invoices")
  • "No description anywhere; no column stays in place." (caption of "A/P Detail scrolled sideways, light")
